TL:DR: not every skill is 30+10, that’s simply the maximum amount for some skills (I.E. Surgery). It varies depending on how fast the skill would level on it’s own: “faster” skills get less assistance from GL, “slower” skills get more assistance (however, the work required is higher due to more and harder tasks). I like your story idea, but it’s not what I’m going for here.

Concerning the skill levels:

I tried to balance the amount of skill levels gained based off of how fast the skill naturally levels. Skills that already progress quickly will gain less skill points from the quests, either because of less quests or because of modified rewards. The reason the maximum skill reward is so high is because some skills (surgery always comes to mind) just level so fricken slowly. Needing to do surgery in the first place is already rare, and you get so few skill points from it, 1.1 per use which is buffed once from skill freshness, but diminishes quickly in raid. That means that to go from level 0 to level 1, you must perform surgery 10 times. 20 for level 1-2, 30 for lvl2-3, climbing up to about 91 uses for every level after 10. That’s 18 full CMS kits and one more use afterwards. If you include skill freshness, only doing one surgery a raid for max freshness, that drops it down to 70 surgery uses. That’s 70 raids, not including the ones you don’t perform surgery. If you were to “grind” surgery, you could maybe get one level every couple days. Tarkov is gonna wipe before you ever realistically hit level 25, LET ALONE 51. If the elite skill is implemented in the game, it should be expected to be reached. That’s just surgery, I picked the most egregious example to make a point, and all skills are different. The 30+10 is only for tasks with 5 tasks, with the +10 being the extreme task that gives +10 to all skills in that group, but is an absolute bitch to complete and is expected to take days of work.

Concerning the story and character:

The idea of a future you helping you out is a very unique idea, I like it! However, that’s not what this is. I implement Christian themes into all of my work, as I want everything to point back to Him. Guiding Light is an angel, or a celestial being if you don’t believe in Christianity (won’t harm your experience with the mod other than maybe not catching a few subtle references). I do like what you explained though, the idea of it coming full circle and being a loop of sorts is a really interesting idea and plays into the mysteriousness of Tarkov. Although, lets be honest, the respawning isn’t a story feature, it’s just a “we can’t make a game this long and complicated where you literally get one life” feature. If you want to do a similar mod to mine with your future self idea, I’d be happy to help you get acquainted to writing quests!

I believe the mod aims to automate the process of adding support for custom guns and such in quests that require specific weapons to be used.

Upon the game’s database loading, the mod initializes and reads its configuration. It then scans every folder inside the user/mods directory for overrides, processes and combines them (if the same weapon/category exists multiple times), and applies them to the quests. Each weapon condition of a quest is matched with the best-matched weapon type or category, and missing ones are added.The mod description explains how other modders can implement this

It doesn’t change the way you play the game in the sense of “You have to fundamentally change how you play Escape From Tarkov in order to experience this mod.” It’s meant to be a new story, as well as a way to fast-track your soft-skill levels by completing challenges related to each skill.
